# SD13-E5 deterministic Human Druid level 5 progression fixture.
# Widens the accepted SD13-E4/E5 deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Human Druid
# level-1/level-2/level-3/level-4 prepared divine spell-bearing baseline to
# level 5 as chosen input only. It names selections; it does not contain
# derived, computed, or parity values. It preserves the accepted Human
# race-choice seam (ability-bonus and bonus-feat), the deterministic
# ability/feat posture from the level-1/level-2/level-3/level-4 fixtures, and
# the same canonical nature-bond selection (animal companion), adding only
# the level bump this bounded tranche needs.
#
# It deliberately avoids every later Druid burden surface: no animal
# companion stat block/advancement/link-share-spells, no wild shape execution,
# no spellbook, no spells prepared, no spell slots, no spell DCs, no bonus
# spells, and no level-6+ progression.
